novelty.justification: The method is now framed as terminal SWD plus kinetic latent bridge matching, which is a clearer contribution.

technical_depth.justification: The SWD formula, bounded-theory paragraph, and architecture table make the method credible, though a full algorithm block and derivation would still help.

experimental_rigor.justification: The paper now includes strict-750 metrics, baseline completion status, qualitative grids, artifact diagnostics, ablations, sweeps, and theory switches. Remaining risk is incomplete AAAI baseline coverage.

evidence_presentation.justification: The Ours-vs-SaMST qualitative grid makes the artifact story much clearer.

writing_clarity.justification: The narrative is coherent but still long and not yet compressed into AAAI style.

reproducibility.justification: Config details, evaluation protocol, paths, and generated workspace are well preserved.

remaining_blockers_for_aaai: The manuscript is 12 pages in article format and must be migrated/compressed into the official AAAI format.
CAST, AesFA, AesPA-Net, and StyTr2 are not yet complete matched strict-750 baselines.
Timing/resource table is still underdeveloped relative to the fast-transfer claim.
Some references are placeholder-quality BibTeX entries and need bibliographic cleanup.
The qualitative grid should ideally include source and target reference panels or separate zoom crops for grain artifacts.
recommended_next_revision: Migrate to official AAAI template and compress to target page count.
Add a small zoomed qualitative figure focusing on SaMST grain and Ours cleanliness.
Complete at least CAST or StyTr2 matched strict-750 baseline before submission.
Add timing/params/VRAM table for Ours, SaMST, StyleID, S2WAT, AdaIN.
Add user preference or artifact-cleanliness study.
